Debora reported a fall at home on Oct 2, 2026 in the kitchen while reaching for a cabinet. Her spouse Kevin found her on the floor. Denies head strike or loss of consciousness. Small skin tear to left forearm, cleaned and dressed. Vitals stable. Fall risk reassessed as high. PT referral placed for gait evaluation.

PT evaluation following fall on Oct 2, 2026. Gait slow and unsteady with intermittent cane use; Timed Up and Go 19 seconds. Recommend front-wheeled walker, home safety evaluation, and grab bars in the bathroom. Will see twice weekly for strength and balance.

Met with Kevin, Debora's spouse and primary caregiver. Kevin reports exhaustion and poor sleep, and is worried about managing evenings alone. Requests respite. Discussed respite options and caregiver support group.
Debora needed hands-on help getting out of the tub today and said she has been skipping showers because she is afraid of slipping.
Chronic conditions reviewed and stable. Continue current plan.

ADL reassessment. Debora now needs moderate assistance with bathing and lower-body dressing; independent at last review. Recommend tub transfer bench, handheld shower, and increasing home care hours for bathing support.
